method: 3 public repos, pinned shas: (1) github.com/mnriem/spec-kit-spring-react-demo @ 8ec8841a66c80b284d0053ba5f236154471bf5e2 -- a real project scaffolded with GitHub spec-kit (.specify/memory/constitution.md + specs/001-llm-perf-analytics/{spec,plan,research}.md); (2) github.com/adr/madr @ ba75bb1b20d42af5746b246ad348c202419ae681 (develop) -- MADR's own docs/decisions/, real MADR-format ADRs; (3) github.com/npryce/adr-tools @ b3279baf9be2207d1a4f4bbd608fd0b591c72aee (master) -- adr-tools' own doc/adr/, real Nygard-format ADRs. Every record file in all 3 was opened and hand-read (not grepped) for title/status/date/deciders/supersedes and for code paths it names; 'expected' below is that reading. A record not naming a committed-to-git code path has anchors: [] and is excluded from the M29b anchored-flags scoring (recordFiles below marks which ones apply).

scoring.M29a_recall: found ids / expected ids, per corpus and overall
scoring.M29a_fields: fields that match exactly (title, status, date when the record format carries it, deciders when it carries it, supersedes/replaces edge count) / fields the ground truth defines, over found records only
scoring.M29b_anchors_flags: for every expected-anchored record, plant a commit that edits a file under its anchor after the record's date, recompute flags, and check the record turns yellow (scope_changed) with the correct anchor path in the reason; matches / anchored records
